name: AOL Australia
summary: America Online's Australian dialup/online service (aol.com.au); home page branded 'Australia Online' (1998) then 'AOL Australia' (from 2000); JV with Seven Network became AOL|7 (2002); brand later discontinued. NOT the Melbourne AUSTRALIA ON LINE PTY LTD (australiaonline.net.au, ACN 064 289 925).

events.details: America Online's Australian online service, c. 1995; earliest Wayback capture 29 Apr 1998 (aol.com.au, 'Welcome to Australia Online').
Became AOL|7 following a joint venture with the Seven Network (2002); AOL-branded ISP service later discontinued.
